strongs_1890.strongs_def: a vine stock (properly, one yielding purple grapes, the richest variety)
strongs_1890.derivation: or שׂוֹרֵק; and (feminine) שֹׂרֵקָה; from H8319 (שָׁרַק) in the sense of redness (compare H8320 (שָׂרֻק));
